mode.ui:help: A deployment-level MUST_LOGIN enforce floor cannot be lowered here.

file.ui:help: Read-only last-known-good path; key material is never returned.

legacy_fallback_relays.ui:help: Explicit Relay servers reserved for ordinary fallback; they never consume quality-candidate slots.

weights.ui:help: RTT, jitter, loss, and load weights are basis points and must sum to 10000.

fixed_node_id.ui:help: Opaque configured node ID; never enter a hostname or URL.

relay_reallocation.ui:help: Manual selector requests one bounded HBBS-coordinated re-evaluation. Candidate names and regions are explicit configuration, and raw telemetry is never exposed.

fast_compat_enabled.ui:help: Issues a short-lived grant for the server-selected Relay; Relay Quality remains authoritative when it has a final decision.

fast_media_v1_enabled.ui:help: Requires authenticated fresh HBBR telemetry with fast_media_relay_udp=1 and a healthy configured UDP endpoint.

relay_max_datagram.ui:help: Authorized outer AKR1 datagram size, including the 32-byte Relay header (608–1400 bytes).
